title: Each account's single largest 2025 invoice
prompt: For each account, what was their single largest invoice (by amount) issued in 2025?
referenceSql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT account_id, invoice_id, amount, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rn FROM invoices WHERE issued_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND issued_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01') SELECT account_id, invoice_id, amount FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
